name: The Afterlight
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: encyclopedia cover illustration for Avarenne, a mature late-industrial occult fantasy novel. Scene: Sealed optical calibration room with a shuttered lamp visibly dark, a separate small invested aperture still emitting a brilliant controlled white beam into a stone receiving panel, concentric silver confinement rings, no sun inside the apparatus or god manifestation. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, tactile architecture and believable materials, dramatic but readable light, atmospheric depth. One coherent scene, landscape 3:2. Show only the specified bounded manifestation; supernatural graphic traces are illustrative, never game interface. Anonymous adult figures only when specified, no named canonical character. No legible text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, card frame or collage. No additional creature, portal, deity, avatar or city-wide catastrophe. Avoid exaggerating the effect beyond its local source.
visual_caption: Un’interfaccia emette la quota luminosa già custodita anche se la sorgente di prova è schermata. Ricostruzione illustrativa, non prova diagnostica o fonte di nuove capacità. La scena mostra un esercizio possibile alle condizioni indicate, non un’attivazione già in corso al T0.
visual_review: APPROVATA: scena, limiti illustrativi e assenza di poteri aggiuntivi verificati
